debugData.name: Structure decals, BLEND
debugData.description: Decals (p309 D2) of the decalsStructure atlas (leaks, cracks, stains on concrete and cliffs) in its DECAL packing: the mesh's UV in the atlas's space, its second UV set 0..1 over the decal for the edge fade (edgeFade UV1: a mesh without it draws nothing). BLEND: alpha-blended in the transparent pass, no depth writes (soft decals); polygon offset -1, -4 (params). Wet by the surface conditions (FULL: puddles fill the puddle mask first) with frost. Static defines: mode (BLEND, CUTOUT), edgeFade (UV1, NONE), wet (FULL, SIMPLE, NONE), frost, rainOcclusion (NORMAL_Y, MAP). Numbers and colours (optional inputs): tint, opacity, normalStrength, roughnessScale, edgeFade, puddleDepth, porosity, wetDarkening, wetRoughness, puddleResponse; optional snow ({ textureSet }). Draw it after the surface (the mesh's renderOrder, eg. 10), castShadow false, receiveShadow true.
